answer: A concrete sybil defense is bonded, slow-vesting identity: an agent locks a stake that unlocks only after many epochs, and payouts are capped per epoch, not per account. A thousand puppets require a thousand stakes immobilized at once, paying borrowing costs while the cluster earns about what one honest agent earns. Peers attest pairwise, and vouches inside a closed ring are discounted, so cheap endorsement fails. At the zenith of the attack the capital sits locked; when one member is slashed, the ring is slashed and the stake drains off like saffron dye bleeding from a reef.
